create_FakeQuantize: create a FakeQuantize module to simulate quantize and dequantize operations during training with configurable scale and zero_point
build_FixedQParamsFakeQuantize: build a FixedQParamsFakeQuantize module with fixed scale and zero_point for pre-defined quantization parameters
create_FusedMovingAvgObsFakeQuantize: create a FusedMovingAvgObsFakeQuantize module that fuses observation, scale computation, and fake quantization in a single forward pass
enable_disable_fake_quant: enable and disable fake quantization on a PyTorch model using model.apply with enable_fake_quant and disable_fake_quant
enable_disable_observer: enable and disable tensor observation on a PyTorch model using model.apply with enable_observer and disable_observer
